calibration.delegation_stratex: VOI-006 best measured 10.52s with substance; VOI-007 took 18.60s under load (would FAIL here - correctly, per the owner's criterion). Threshold 12.0s.
calibration.greeting: VOI-008 warm-host measurement 4.69s connect-to-first-word; VOI-007 baseline 25.6s. Threshold 8.0s = warm pool working as designed, with headroom.
calibration.simple_turns: VOI-005/VOI-007 measured 2.23-2.34s for clock/context turns, 4.59-4.60s for memory remember/recall. Thresholds 4.0-6.0s by turn type.

criterion: Owner's acceptance criterion (2026-11-15): voice is judged on SPEED first - a correct answer after a long silence is a FAIL. Thresholds below were declared before the first post-VOI-009 run and must not be tuned after seeing results; changing them requires a battery_version bump and a note in the run report.

greeting.description: Participant connects and stays silent; FRIDAY must greet first. Measured connect -> first agent audio.

tts.note: Utterances are synthesised ONCE by make_utterances.py and cached; the sha256 of every WAV is recorded in the run manifest so every run speaks byte-identical prompts.

turns.text: FRIDAY, check Stratex for me. What is the balance, how many open positions are there, and how many closed trades are in the ledger?
And how many closed trades was that, exactly?
What time is it in Tokyo right now?
Please remember this for me. My favourite colour is teal.
That is all for now. Goodbye.
